summary: Third composite front end, requested by the user. maskComp/paintComp put the selected entry ON TOP and cut a hole to reveal the slot image underneath; this inverts the stack - the slot image goes on top at its own size, positioned and scaled by a gizmo with the shape gizmo's handles, and its OWN alpha is the cut, so no mask and no brush. Headline flow is grab an object from the internet, Remove Background, place it into an existing generation, then detail it to blend. BLOCKED BY MPI-377: that flow starts with a drag-drop into the History workspace, which today silently becomes a prompt chip instead of an entry, so there is no project-file URL for the slot and nothing for Remove Background to run on. The server half likely needs NO new code - POST /project/apply-paint plus compositeOverlay() already flattens an alpha-carrying RGBA layer onto a base - if the transform is rasterised into a full-frame scratch layer client-side; its ceiling (PAINT_MAX_EDGE 4096 plus fit:fill, so a small object on an 8K base is resampled up) and the upgrade path (send the placement rect, let Sharp composite at source resolution) are both written into the brief. Placement gets its OWN scratch layer, never paintCanvas, for the reason docs/composite.md already records: the paint layer persists per entry.
Folded into umbrella MPI-562 by the consolidation sweep.

Redesigned with the user 2026-08-21. Now the Place tool: a real registered composite tool with a slot fed by drop, MpiMediaPicker or Paste, plus a Remove Background toggle. Absorbs MPI-377's drop routing. Title, description and all 14 acceptance lines rewritten; unblocked from blocked to planned.

Compact plan attached. Investigation done inline, no sub-agents. Resolved the one open decision: Remove Background runs on the SLOT via deferCommit (HOLD-UNTIL-APPLY, MPI-306) so the cutout lands on disk with a URL and is committed nowhere - _runImageTool cannot be reused because it hardwires the current entry and appends. Also found a gap: mask-tool-registry.test.cjs guards no composite tool at all.

Started the build. The gizmo reuses ShapeManager with a third destination 'place' rather than a forked manager; the placed image and its full-res rasterise live on CompositeManager, which resetComposite() already drops on the one preview seam.

Place shipped and verified on a private app instance. 663 node tests + 24 desktop pass; the seven new registry guards mutation-proved RED. Live: three fill gestures, the gizmo (SHIFT aspect lock held to 0.996), alpha honoured to the pixel (preview and written file both 9112 px over the same 134x68 bbox), and Remove Background on deferCommit leaving the media on disk with the project record untouched - its first live consumer since MPI-306. Fixed one bug found live: Apply reloads the entry it creates, which cleared the gizmo and left Apply enabled over nothing (the 2026-08-04 cut bug's shape); re-seeded in loadImage. HELD IN VALIDATING for one user ruling: acceptance 12 (undo) is built as the paint-Apply contract rather than a gizmo transform history, because a placement writes no layer pixels and the shape gizmo's drag is not undoable either.
